import os
d='fuzz/http2-corpus'
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
    data=open(os.path.join(d,f),'rb').read()
    # check for valid preface
    if data.startswith(b'PRI * HTTP/2.0'):
        # parse frames
        off=0
        types=set()
        sids=set()
        while off+9<=len(data):
            length=int.from_bytes(data[off:off+3],'big')
            ftype=data[off+3]
            sid=int.from_bytes(data[off+5:off+9],'big')
            if length>10000 or off+9+length>len(data):
                break
            types.add(ftype)
            sids.add(sid)
            off+=9+length
        if 5 in types:  # PRIORITY frame
            print(f, 'types=',sorted(types),'sids=',sorted(sids))
" 2>/dev/null | head -30
